== Summary ==
Players Committee errata slip for Death Star II: Coolant Shaft, cut unchanged at 300 dpi from page 12 of the PC's ''Decipher Errata'' sheet “Official text as of March 1, 2017” (PDF made 31 May 2017): [http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf DErrata.pdf]. Preserved copy of the sheet: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705005900/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf Internet Archive]. SHA-1 of this file: 2629fac2f067cb29d48e15ad39a3d2ef08e75f51. Shown on [[Death Star II: Coolant Shaft (PC Errata 2017 slip)]].

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-6/6c/DS2-D-deathstariicoolantshaft-PC-Errata-2017-slip.png Internet Archive item].
